reviews.text: Maggie did an amazing job grooming our puppy! We were so impressed with the results. Our little guy walked out of the salon looking like he was ready to strut down the runway! 😂 The pricing was very reasonable, and you can really tell how much care and dedication Maggie puts into her work. Highly recommend!

My dog had the pleasure of being groomed by Maggie today. It was a wonderful experience for both of us, easy to book, comprehensive pricing and transparency of pricing, incredible operators and a really nice clean studio. My dog is usually itchy and a little embarrassed after a big chop and she strutted out so proud and happy! That made two of us :) I will recommend Maggie and Pawllywood to anyone I meet who is in need of a gorgeous groom! Flawless experience, perfect service! Thank you again!
Thank you for the good reviews! ❤️❤️❤️

Both Aney and Maggie are wonderful! They made our little girl Maple look so freaking cute. Aney even put tiny plaits in her hair, which is just ridiculously adorable 🥹 We love the cut they gave her and especially appreciate that each dog gets their own dedicated time here. Thank you both for taking such good care of Maple! ❤️ …

Best grooming my dog has ever gotten. He came back looking like a teddy bear. Maggie was wonderful and extremely friendly. My dog came back happy and looking amazing. Would recommend it to anyone looking for fantastic service.

We brought our cockapoo here for the first time. Couldn’t be happier! They were really responsive to my inquire about an estimate for the groom, and they actually stuck to the price that they quoted, unlike other groomers.

Super straight forward with how we wanted our dog to be groomed. Will definitely visit again!

Best haircut ever! Not only did our Bichonfrise, Monty, look amazing, but he was super happy when we picked him up, and looked at Aney, the groomer, so lovingly!  She took my comments and requests into consideration, and did what was realistically possible. Loved it!! I am only sad that I met Aney as we were leaving Toronto. But for sure, we will be back to get another haircut for Monty!!
This was my baby dog’s first time here, and I would definitely recommend this pet spa. Maggie was warm and professional, and she gave my dog top-tier care. We will definitely go back here.
amazing service from Aney! she has cleaned my cat twice now and she has done an amazing job each time!

Brought my senior Pomeranian–Chihuahua here for grooming, and she came out looking perfect and incredibly calm. Pawllywood Pet Grooming treated her with so much patience, care, and love. You can truly feel how much they respect and understand senior dogs. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!
This pet grooming service did an excellent job-my pet looks clean,happy,and well cared for.the staff were gentle,professional,and clearly love animals!

I had to get my cat in for an emergency groom and pawllywood was so accommodating and helpful. The groomer who worked on my cat was so gentle and thorough! My usually mouthy cat didn’t make a peep during the service and she looks amazing :)
Maggie is so good with our Nova. She is quite anxious and Maggie knows how to make her relax and give her such a cute cut. Not too short which I love!

I took my Australian Shepherd Sofie, for the first time today at this location. I was beyond pleasantly surprised! Maggie did an amazing job, Sofie never looked so happy and fresh. We can't wait to be back!

We’ve been following Maggie from her previous shop to this one, and she has groomed our dog since he was a puppy. She never disappoints! Maggie is caring, professional, and always makes our dog look amazing. We wouldn’t trust anyone else. Highly recommend her! 🐶💖 …

Maggie did an amazing job! My pet looks absolutely beautiful after grooming. She’s gentle, professional, and really knows how to make pets feel comfortable. Even though she now relocated to this Toronto  shop, the quality and care are still top-notch. Highly recommend Maggie!

I brought my dog Edna to Pawllywood yesterday for her birthday haircut and Aney did such an amazing job! She is so sweet and kind. I felt her warm energy the second I walked in. I don’t think Edna’s ever looked cuter! Thanks again for everything Aney! I’ll definitely be coming here regularly.
I am a loyal customer of Aney’s services for my bichon poo! She always listens and grooms my puppy exactly how I want! She does beautiful teddy bear grooms. Absolutely recommend.
@OlivetheSassyPoo just had her first puppy cut and WOW… it’s pawtastic!!! Highly recommend, we will be back. Xx🫒 …

Don’t recommend bringing your cats here!
They are not experienced enough
They did a phenomenal job with our bichon. Best haircut she’s received in the city of Toronto. They followed instructions perfectly and flora (our dog) looks amazing. 10/10 recommend.
I like this store very much, it turns my boy into a clean and cute boy every time. He is very happy to come here

Amy is an incredible pet groomer at Pawllywood! She’s patient, gentle, and truly has a gift when it comes to working with animals. My pet always comes home looking fantastic and happy, which says a lot about the care and attention Amy provides. Highly recommend her if you’re looking for someone who treats your furry friend like family!

An amazing groomer who names is Aney,  she is very experienced and kind groomer, We've been bringing my elderly dog in Xmas,   and received excellent care and groomed, the staff here is amazing, They were also very kind to us. now I have a new kitten and again the care and service provided has been excellent. A+++!
Thank you for making my Bichon cute !
Have a great experience with this location!
Thank you so much for you positive review ❤️
Thank you so much for grooming my Yorkie, she looks great and i lobe it♥️

Living downtown, we used to trek to Markham to go to Pawllywood because we loved their cut, service and value. Since we moved to another area, we have been going to other groomers, which have been ok.

While walking on Queen St. one day, I was surprised to see a Pawllywood in downtown Toronto and realized it was the same one as the one in Markham.

We immediately booked an appointment for our small poodle mix, and there was a lot of availability that fit the times we were free.

The day of our girl's grooming took two hours, and she had the best care ever. Her cut was so cute, and we loved the grooming report that we received afterwards. Our dog, who is usually anxious at the groomer's, was instantly relaxed. Similar to their location in Pawllywood, we were impressed with the service and the value that Pawllywood offers.

We are very happy that Pawllywood now has a location downtown, and will now be our go-to groomer.

Both of my dogs went to Anie for grooming. They look amazing every time.
She is knowledgeable and attentive to details
Highly recommended!
